Treasury press release indicating U.S.-Taiwan tax negotiations to address double taxation; policy momentum supports congressional action.

Senate companion bill S.199 was introduced on 01/23/2025, read twice and referred to the Committee on Finance.
Senate press release notes bipartisan, bicameral introduction of US-Taiwan tax legislation; companion to H.R.33.
